_comment: Awin feeds used by Car Gear World. advertiserId is the Awin advertiser id (file names AWIN_<advertiserId>_<feedId>.csv.gz in the Awin archive). Without feedIds, every file of that retailer in the archive is read. Add a retailer only after Awin has approved the programme. retailer is the name shown on the site; VEVOR has the NL flag (site.config.js retailerCountries).
